name: SceneTransform_ApplyYaw
domain: Builds and publishes the yaw rotation matrix used by the battle-presentation camera.
expressed: computes the fixed-point sine and cosine for the requested angle
places cosine, sine, and negated sine in the Y-axis yaw rotation cells
publishes the complete transform to the shared scene workspace

bounded_search.reason: The complete readable candidate is four bytes short with 39 differing halfwords and misses exact-extent and <=20-halfword admission.

The sibling at 08004bd4 was corrected to SceneTransform_ApplyPitch after auditing the matrix cells; 08004c1c is the Y-axis yaw transform.
